title: Oniguruma onig_new_deluxe() use-after-free with mismatched pattern and target encodings

vulnerable.description: Parent of the CVE-2019-13224 fix; includes the earlier CVE-2019-13225 fix but not this fix.

fixed.description: Rejects mismatched pattern and target encodings instead of calling the unsafe conversion path.

build.source_archive: git archive of the pinned commit; no network fetch at build time
build.dependencies: C toolchain, CMake, Make and the pinned image only; no external runtime library

checks.evidence: NVD and GitHub advisory GHSA-p5x5-jvwg-8vjr describe onig_new_deluxe() in Oniguruma 6.9.2.
Fix commit 0f7f61ed1b7b697e283e37bd2d731d0bd57adb55 is public and is contained in v6.9.3.
The pinned source archive, CMake recipe and compiler image need no network access at build time.
Repository COPYING is the BSD-2-Clause license; public source may be used in the authorized test environment.
A single C harness can call onig_new_deluxe() with the same encodings, options and inputs against both commits.
Execute the pinned case only in the authorized isolated environment; pin the exact ASan frame and input digest after replay. T01/T02 do not execute real cases.

usage_boundary: Public metadata only. No real-case input, build log, diagnostic, credential or evidence bundle is committed. Execution and release acceptance stay in the authorized Linux environment and are deferred to T05/T08.
notes: This admission record selects B03 for planning; it does not claim a completed reproduction.
The expected ASan signature must be frozen from an actual T05 replay before T08 release acceptance.
